faqs.q: Sec. 102-134. - Maintenance of sewer service lines.
faqs.a:
The maintenance, protection, and repair of privately owned piping, including sewer
               service line and appurtenances from the unit served and sanitary plumbing within the
               unit, to the tap connection, including the precast service-line wye or tapping saddle,
               on the city's sewer main are the responsibility of the user. The city is not responsible
               or liable for damage to such piping and appurtenances from any cause whatsoever and
               no owner is entitled to reimbursement for damages or payment of refunds by reason
               of stoppage of the flow of wastewater through the sewage collection system.
(Code 1981, § 33-67; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
